content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Macon

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—which account for your degree level and years leading projects—to confirm you meet the baseline. Granite PM Academy can answer eligibility questions during a free consultation.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Our instructors deliver the full PMI-required contact hours on a schedule that fits working professionals in Macon. You'll cover the PMP domains, frameworks, and real-world scenarios in real time.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the course, submit your application to PMI along with the required exam fee. Granite PM Academy will guide you through the online application process to ensure accuracy and speed your approval to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce what you learned. When you're ready, schedule your exam at a testing center or online and demonstrate your mastery of project-management practices.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP renews on a three-year cycle. Throughout each cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) by attending training, volunteering, or contributing to the profession. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education options to help you meet renewal requirements.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
